title: Asynchrony Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon LLM Agentic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.04196v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Synchronous policy updates can limit the efficiency of post-training for long-horizon LLM agents. When trajectories span multiple interaction turns, completion times can vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers idling, wasting compute resources. Asynchronous reinforcement learning addresses this inefficiency but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) are a backpropagation-free alternative to gradient-based training, yet require many perturbed-policy evaluations and have remained largely synchronous in current LLM post-training. We introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and investigate its training behavior under stale fitness measurements. On WebShop, we systematically vary the lag and fraction of stale fitness measurements and additionally introduce two stress tests to probe extreme staleness cases. translated_title: 在长时程LLM智能体任务上，异步化对进化策略而言几乎零成本
translated_abstract: 同步策略更新会限制长时程LLM智能体后训练的效率。当轨迹跨越多个交互轮次时，完成时间可能差异很大，同步更新屏障会使较快的计算节点闲置，浪费计算资源。异步强化学习可以解决这一低效问题，但会引入策略滞后和离策略优化。进化策略（ES）是一种无需反向传播的基于梯度训练的替代方案，但需要大量扰动策略的评估，且在当前的LLM后训练中基本保持同步方式。我们提出了带有有界陈旧性的异步进化策略，并研究了其在陈旧适应度测量下的训练行为。在WebShop基准上，我们系统地改变滞后程度和陈旧适应度测量的比例，并额外引入两个压力测试来探测极端陈旧性的情形。结果表明，自然异步的表现与同步进化策略几乎完全一致，而性能退化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出带 有界陈旧性的异步进化策略，证明在长时程LLM智能体任务的后训练中，异步化几乎不损失性能即可消除同步屏障造成的算力浪费，且无需反向传播。
en_tdlr: Bounded-staleness asynchronous evolution strategies nearly match synchronous ES performance on long-horizon LLM agentic tasks, eliminating idle compute from synchronization barriers without backpropagation.
